comments.author: @nicholasmeola920
comments.text: When i first started to watch this i thought it was a movie then all of a sudden another episode appeared. I didn't realize it was a series, probably because of the length of the first episode. It was a long slow burn but i stayed with it. I thought it was incredible but as a warning this is not for the faint of heart. This was one of if not the most brutal and disturbing shows i have ever seen. It goes to a place so dark i don't think i could watch  anything like this again. The acting is superb and the cinematography is incredible. If Brubaker ever does a film version of Kill or Be Killed Miles Teller is the man for the part.

comments.text: This series felt like a book. You get ALL the details and textures.
